# Olympus PEN E-PM2

E101, TruePic VI (2012): one camera-tested mod; its addresses and edits do not carry over to newer bodies.

**Model code:** E101 · **Also known as:** E-PM2, PEN mini E-PM2, EPM2 · **Stock firmware covered:** 1.6
